supersedes: research/wp1a/wp1a_cost_quality_categories.json (kept as history; the word 'dominance' is retired for WP-1b)

analyses.P_primary_fail_closed: every agent EMPTY prediction counts as an empty predicted set
analyses.S_instrument_failure_excluded_paired: drop from BOTH arms every task whose agent empty_reason in {truncation, parser_failure, infrastructure}; report how many were dropped. round_cap is NOT dropped: failing to decide within 8 calls is agent behaviour, not an instrument failure.

quality_verdicts_ordered.condition: Q5(D) > -0.05 in both P and S, and Q2.5(D) > 0 in P
Q5(D) > -0.05 in both P and S, and Q97.5(D) < 0 in P (non-inferior, but statistically lower F1 inside the margin; this must be stated in every summary)
Q5(D) > -0.05 in both P and S
Q5(D) > -0.05 in exactly one of P, S
none of the above. Never call this 'equivalence'.

quality_verdict_rule: Take the FIRST row that matches, top to bottom. One-sided alpha = 0.05; NI first, then superiority; no multiplicity correction needed for this order.

cost_verdict.statistic: ratio RM-CSS / Agent of the per-task means for total tokens, model calls, and USD, with paired task-bootstrap CIs (same resampling as B3)
cost_verdict.views: two views in wp1a_accounting_schema.json (marginal; amortized setup at N)
cost_verdict.CHEAPER: the upper 95% CI bound of the ratio is below 1 on all three dimensions, decided on View A (marginal cost); View B (amortized setup) is reported alongside

final_categories.rule: verdict 2 or 3 + CHEAPER (verdict 2 carries its mandatory note)
not CHEAPER (report the quality verdict alongside)

dominance_retired: The word 'dominance' is retired for WP-1b.
notes: Both analyses P and S are preregistered; the primary fail-closed analysis and the instrument-failure-excluded sensitivity analysis remain distinct.
round_cap is NOT excluded by the instrument-failure sensitivity analysis (agent behaviour).
